note: APPLIED 2026-08-27 (additive/idempotent, DORMANT — no client flip). THE BANK ITEM STORE (G.bank's item container, separate from the bag G.inventory) becomes server-of-record. Adds table public.player_bank (user_id, slot, item_id, qty>0) — PK (user_id, slot, item_id), RLS own-read only, NO client write policy — mirroring player_inventory so the client folds res.bank through the SAME serverOwnedItem carve-out and the SAME inventory arm (INVENTORY_ARM_ENABLED, post-wipe) as the bag. ARCHITECTURE: a SEPARATE table rather than a `container` column on player_inventory, BY DESIGN — a container dimension must join the (user_id,slot,item_id) PK (a player holds the same item in bag AND bank as distinct rows), which would force a non-additive rewrite of every player_inventory touch in the live 86KB hr_apply authority engine; a separate table delivers the identical client contract (res.bank + hr_bank_move) and security model while touching NOTHING on the live hr_apply path. §1b extends player_ledger.kind CHECK to allow 'bank' (drop-and-re-add carrying every existing kind incl.
